title: Month-end scheduling
description: Scheduling January 31 one month ahead crashes. December also fails to roll into the next year. Preserve the day when possible; otherwise use the target month's last day.

title: Discount rounding
description: The checkout drops fractional cents instead of rounding half up after applying the discount to the complete basket. Input prices are integer cents and discount_bps is basis points.

title: Webhook retries
description: A retried event is counted twice. Apply each event ID only once, preserve the first occurrence and report duplicate IDs once in order of first duplicate.
source:
def solve(args):
    return {'total': sum(e['delta'] for e in args['events']), 'duplicates': []}
